# jurisdiction polity

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:jurisdictionPolity`](gmeow-jurisdictionPolity.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/jurisdictionPolity>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

The governing polity (state, administrative body, or organization) that held jurisdiction over the place during this tenure. Functional: a single tenure has exactly one governing polity.
